hints.title: Identical Query String Branch
hints.text: Distinguish between the case where word1 and word2 are different versus the case where they refer to the exact same string.

hints.title: Consecutive Duplicate Step Evaluation
hints.text: When word1 equals word2, measure distance between the current occurrence and the immediately preceding occurrence of that same word.

hints.title: Single Pass Dual Tracker Branching
hints.text: If word1 equals word2, keep the previous index and on every match update minimum distance with i minus prev, then set prev to i. If different, update pointers and minimize absolute difference.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * L) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting indices into separate arrays and nested looping takes extra memory and quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Differentiating identical vs distinct query words in a single loop avoids extra allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the identical string edge case smoothly without duplicating loop logic.
